posts.cooked: How to access OPPE questions that is on 16 Aug 2025?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Same way you did NPPE, ssh into oppe vm and go to se2001 then create the question dir and follow the same steps as you did NPPE or BPT

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
yes the same way but ensure its the exact question name. The question name will be on the portal or you can do ls \opt\se2001

If your query is resolved do not reply back
